# Arelis Dominican Salon

> Dominican hair salon in Orlando, Florida, open since 2010. Specialists in Dominican blowouts, keratin and deep repair treatments, silk press for natural and 4c hair, and hair color. Bilingual staff (English and Spanish). Located at 6845 W Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32818. Phone: (407) 601-3628.

## Key facts

- Name: Arelis Dominican Salon
- Type: Hair salon (Dominican-style salon)
- Address: 6845 W Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32818, USA (West Orlando, on W Colonial Dr / State Road 50)
- Phone: (407) 601-3628 — bookings by phone
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM–7:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Appointments recommended; walk-ins welcome
- Languages: English and Spanish
- In business since 2010 (15+ years serving Orlando)
- Google rating: 4.3 stars from 300+ reviews
- Prices: vary by hair length and type; call for a quote
- Website: https://arelisdominicansalonfl.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/arelisdominicansalon/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Arelisdominican/

## Best known for

- Dominican blowout: deep wash and conditioning, round-brush blow-dry with heat and tension; straight, bouncy, healthy hair without chemicals. Works on natural, relaxed and textured hair.
- Keratin and deep repair treatments: smooths frizz, resists Florida humidity, adds shine; results typically last weeks to months.
- Silk press: sleek, glossy press for natural hair, including 4c hair, without relaxers.
- Hair color: all-over color, balayage, highlights, gray coverage and color correction.
